title: Recorded usage
description: One observed action in the front application. A password field sets secure and keeps the typed characters out of the event.

at.description: When the action was observed, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

targetText.description: The control's own words. Empty when the front application only changed. For typing, the field label and, unless the field is secure, the field's resulting text.

secure.description: True only when the control is a password field.

stateTexts.description: Visible labels in the front window after the action.
